tools.name: find_help
tools.description: The shops on HandledIQ near a US ZIP code that can do what the person needs: each with its book prices, its soonest open times, its signed record and a quote_id to hold a time with. Soonest first, three at most.

tools.name: hold_time
tools.description: Holds one open time from a quote for 10 minutes and has the shop text the person a link to book it or say it was not them. Nothing is booked until the person taps yes. The same call again, while it is held, texts no one. The quote_id may come from any shop find_help or get_quote gave.

tools.name: booking_status
tools.description: Where a quote stands: priced, waiting on the person (with minutes left on the hold), booked (when and with whom), said it was not them, or the hold ran out. tools.name: request_service
tools.description: Opens HandledIQ's quote window on one shop, for the person themselves: they pick what they need, see the shop's own book price and real open times, and hold a time; the shop texts them and only their tap books it. Returns who the shop is and the work it prices.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: The shop's own book prices for what the person needs and its next real open times. Returns a quote_id to hold a time with. visit: no fixed price for exactly that, so the price is the shop's visit to find the problem. tools.name: verify_record
tools.description: Checks a signed record from any HandledIQ shop (a house's, a technician's or a shop's): valid, with who signed it and the record it holds, or not valid and why. Anyone can make the same check with the key at the issuer's id.
